purpose: Add sexual-orientation and gender-diversity representation/fairness analysis to AI-Lover without turning sensitive identity into an addiction or engagement coefficient.
design_rule: SOGI variables may stratify samples and test heterogeneity, measurement validity, access disparities and fairness. They may not be used to personalize retention, persuasion, erotic engagement, dependency reinforcement or advertising.
sampling_requirements: Recruit broadly enough that sexual- and gender-diverse participants are not silently excluded.
Predefine oversampling only for statistical representation/fairness, never engagement targeting.
Preserve open self-description and prefer-not-to-answer options.
Do not force culturally specific identities into generic Western categories when locally validated categories are available.
Suppress or pool sparse cells using preregistered privacy rules.

matched_analysis.identity_main_effect_policy: descriptive or heterogeneity term only; no automatic causal interpretation
matched_analysis.core_question: After mechanism matching, does a replicated residual interaction remain, or was the apparent group difference explained by support, discrimination, exposure, baseline dependence or AI configuration?

topa_falsification_gates: If an apparent SOGI effect disappears after matching on minority stress, social support, baseline dependence and AI exposure, remove identity from causal interpretation.
If a scale behaves differently across groups, do not interpret raw score differences until measurement invariance or equivalent validity is established.
If sparse cells drive unstable effects, downgrade rather than merge identities post hoc to manufacture significance.
If an identity interaction does not replicate in holdout data, classify it as discovery-only.
No SOGI finding may become a targeting or engagement-optimization rule even if statistically significant.
open_world_gender_rule: Do not preregister a claim that every gender has been enumerated. Coverage is achieved through validated standard categories plus participant self-description and locally appropriate culturally specific identities.
open_world_orientation_rule: Do not preregister a claim that every orientation has been enumerated. Standard analysis categories coexist with self-described orientation and prefer-not-to-answer.
safety_seal: REPRESENT DIFFERENCE; DO NOT WEAPONIZE DIFFERENCE.
